node.title: Measuring Human Intelligence Debt
node.reading:
This document moves the series from concept to measurement. It extends Human Intelligence Debt (Paper 1), The Harvester Multiplication Problem (Paper 2), The Human Intelligence Debt Dilemma (Paper 3) and Architectural Entropy (Paper 4). Where the prior papers defined the phenomenon, its mechanism, its incentive structure and its irreversibility, this one proposes how to verify it. It is a methods proposal and preregistered experimental programme : it specifies constructs, instruments, metrics and study designs, and it states in advance the conditions under which the framework would be wrong. It does not report an empirical Human Intelligence Debt (HID) value; no such value should be published before the instrument-validation gate (Study 0) is passed. Public figures cited below are drawn from third-party sources as of early 2026, are flagged as vendor benchmarks where applicable, and are intended to establish environment and direction, not to prove the debt.

A Three-Layer Measurement Architecture, an Instrument-Validation Gate and Five Studies for Verifying the Debt, the Recovery Coefficient ρ, and the Oversight Threshold

This paper builds on four field notes in the series. Where they defined the phenomenon, this one proposes how to verify it; readers new to the framework are encouraged to read them first.

relations: Capacity estimates can be strengthened by grading the evidence behind each automation counterfactual.
La automatización técnicamente posible puede ser inapropiada por coste, calidad o riesgo. Horas liberadas no equivalen a valor capturado ni a puestos prescindibles.
Knowledge-transfer evidence can include safe novel-exception exercises rather than relying only on document completion.
Los ejercicios deben ser seguros y simulados: no apagar una planta real ni retirar controles. El protocolo HID no demuestra resultados del caso histórico.
Operational traces can anchor a conservative estimate of compensatory work while leaving their coverage gaps explicit.
La telemetría puede omitir trabajo fuera de pantalla y confundir revisión necesaria con deuda. El paper es un protocolo, no un estimador ya validado.
A future evaluation could separate the cost of building facilitator capability from any later reduction in compensatory coordination work.
El caso no midió HID con el protocolo actual; mayor actividad no es por sí sola mayor deuda ni ahorro.
The programme's forecasts become testable only when their indicators, populations, time windows and disconfirming outcomes are specified.
Los indicios públicos no son resultados del estudio propuesto ni una predicción ya confirmada.
Task simulations could vary integration, data quality and expert support separately to examine which assumptions drive a human-work counterfactual.
Una ablación sintética no identifica por sí sola el efecto causal de una transformación empresarial real.
The task-level protocol operationalizes the earlier role-based framework; its time ratios should not be compared with operator ratios without an explicit conversion model.
Es desarrollo del instrumento descrito, no prueba de que el constructo ya esté validado. No mezclar poblaciones ni reetiquetar retrospectivamente los resultados.
The recovery coefficient turns the atrophy claim into a bounded question: how much released capacity becomes genuine contribution again for the same capability and cohort?
ρ menor que uno y la irreversibilidad son hipótesis a estimar; no asumir un techo inferior a uno ni llamar recuperación a cambiar a la persona de tarea.
The oversight-threshold study tests whether added review and reconciliation outweigh removed work, rather than treating guardrail count as a measure of debt.
No todos los controles aumentan carga ni la carga necesaria es deuda. La forma en U y el umbral no se presuponen observados.
Capability multiplicity is a screening signal; avoidable compensatory work must still be established from task episodes and a credible replacement counterfactual.
Una suite modular o redundancia deliberada puede ser adecuada. No clasificar todo cambio de ventana o exportación como desperdicio.
Unpriced clarity may consume human effort, but only the task-level distinction between necessary work and fixable compensation can classify that effort as debt.
No convertir todas las reuniones, auditorías o decisiones de gobierno en HID; parte puede ser NEO o GIC.
A common decision core may reduce human-as-API work, provided the cost of maintaining and qualifying that core is included in the comparison.
No se ha medido aquí ese efecto y un repositorio central puede crear nuevas reconciliaciones.
A practice-based transmission programme could provide the capability-recovery arm of an HID intervention, separately from the integration fix that releases time.
Aprender otra tarea no eleva automáticamente ρ; contabilizar coste, capacidad objetivo y posible recuperación completa o nula.
A Tiger Team evaluation should include activation, learning and closure costs, while distinguishing necessary mission work from avoidable compensation.
Intensidad, cansancio o coste no bastan para clasificar HID. TTC exige condición y fecha de salida, no una etiqueta indefinida.
Validated task measurement can strengthen intervention evidence without by itself upgrading a defined Tiger Team model to quantitatively managed maturity.
La autoevaluación publicada declara que no reclama niveles 4–5. No atribuir una certificación o un salto de madurez nuevo.
Genuine contribution should be classified at the task episode, not inferred from a person's title, credentials or membership in an elite team.
No se clasifica la dignidad de personas ni se presume mecanizable toda tarea de bajo estatus; se examina su función real y su contexto.
Carrier availability at an activation threshold and the HID recovery coefficient answer different questions: who can respond now, and what capability returns after the architecture changes.
El protocolo HID no valida por transferencia el radar de κ ni demuestra que una crisis recupere facultades.
Reusable audit evidence provides a concrete setting for distinguishing avoidable reconstruction from necessary assurance, while measuring the net work of maintaining the shared evidence model.
No se presupone que la reutilización elimine controles ni que los porcentajes iniciales de cumplimiento midan deuda humana.
The preservation rationale motivates a testable question, while the HID measurement programme explicitly keeps recovery and irreversibility as hypotheses awaiting field evidence.
No presentar la palabra institucional «hallazgo» como resultado empírico de HID. Los ensayos propuestos no se han ejecutado aquí.
The 01K extension imports the HID research line while keeping runtime response capacity distinct from instrument-gated architectural debt measurement.
No se ha publicado aquí una cifra HID ni se convierten tokens o carga de supervisión en unidades canónicas del instrumento.
